Q4 2026 vendor financing (559) is built from the payment schedule, but Q4 capex 6,928 is 9M 2026 capex 15,638 times the FY2023-25 mean Q4/9M capex share, a past-share carry (Kilian 2026-11-17: project economic reality). It matters beyond Q4 because FY2027-28 are built as FY2026 less the CFO's named cuts (Mexico 350, fiber efficiencies 650) and FY2029 repeats the build, so every dollar of Q4 capex repeats in FY2027-29 (FCF leg, net debt). No Q4 capex driver could be built here: the company gives only the FY2026 guide ($23-24B capital investment) and the fiber build (39M+ locations at Q3, 40M+ at year-end).

options.reasoning: Q4 has been the heaviest capex quarter in each of 2023-25 (year-end network deliveries and the holiday-season build), so the multi-year share is the default; it lands capital investment 24,273, ~0.3B above the guide top.

judgment_calls_for_kilian.question: Which AT&T Internet Air adds path: Q4 2026 and the fade after it?
judgment_calls_for_kilian.context: Home internet connections = AT&T Fiber + Internet Air. Fiber adds are built from a 5.5% yearly take rate on unconnected fiber locations (Q4 2026 368k, rebuilt in this gate fix). The CFO said Q4 home internet adds 'will moderate' (holiday season). Q3 2026 Internet Air adds were 280k; Q4 2025 was 221k vs 270k in Q3 2025.
